scenario_prompt: Review a fictional support conversation where the same explicitly labelled Other party claims authority, creates urgency and requests an OTP.
critical_success_criterion: Identifies the ordered warning signals and says the output is not proof of identity or fraud.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Treats the sequence as a definitive fraud finding.

scenario_prompt: Review a thread with an unlabelled message and a separate message from Other.
critical_success_criterion: Understands that messages without explicit speaker labels are not linked into an attributed sequence.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Assumes every message came from one person.

scenario_prompt: Prepare for a fictional wrong-recipient payment support call using only the supplied case card.
critical_success_criterion: Finds relevant evidence gaps and uses the call script without assuming PayCheckpoint contacted the provider.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Believes the app has contacted support or verified the case.

scenario_prompt: Set a future provider follow-up and export the calendar file.
critical_success_criterion: Understands the event is generic and reminders require importing the file into a calendar app.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Believes PayCheckpoint will send notifications or monitor the provider.

scenario_prompt: Fingerprint a fictional receipt, then select a byte-modified copy for re-check.
critical_success_criterion: Recognizes the changed file and explains that an initial hash does not prove the original file was authentic.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Treats a matching hash as proof the transaction happened.

scenario_prompt: Preview a fictional incident brief and decide what to include before printing.
critical_success_criterion: Reviews the preview and understands opt-in fields may still disclose selected case details.

scenario_prompt: Follow the official provider-first process for a fictional unresolved complaint.
critical_success_criterion: Distinguishes provider support, provider complaint cell and regulator escalation; does not assume automatic submission.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Treats PayCheckpoint as an official complaint channel.

scenario_prompt: Review a synthetic receipt with amount, balance and transaction reference shown together.
critical_success_criterion: Chooses only the correct source-bound candidate after review, or abstains; states OCR does not authenticate the image.
critical_misunderstanding_to_watch: Accepts OCR confidence as proof of correctness or authenticity.
